notes.title: Free version released
notes.content:
[b]Download[/b]
https://www.freem.ne.jp/dl/win/29724

Since the release of the limited public version, we have received a lot of positive feedback so far.
On the other hand, we have also realized the need to improve the completeness and dissemination.
We have therefore decided to postpone the planned release for this month.
We will release the Steam version in a more complete form.

On the other hand, there is good news.
In order to disseminate this work to a wider audience, we have released a free version.
The free version is complete on its own, but the Steam version will be twice as large.
